name: How long does a laundry room lighting upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a laundry room lighting upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a laundry room lighting upgrade depends on the complexity of the project. A straightforward replacement of existing fixtures can often be completed within a single day. Projects involving new wiring, adding more recessed lights, or relocating switches will take longer, potentially two to three days. We strive to minimize disruption and will provide a clear timeline during the initial consultation, factoring in material delivery and installation time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple upgrades can take a day. More complex projects with new wiring or additional fixtures may take two to three days. We provide clear timelines.
